tech.summary: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, which it calls the most capable US open-weight model to date. The 816-billion-parameter model has a 1 million token context window, is natively multimodal, and was built for coding and agentic work. Meta worked with Apple to optimize it for the M5 Ultra chip, though running it locally still needs at least 1TB of RAM. The model is available now through several API platforms.
tech.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model built for Macs

tech.summary: Google announced it will display website links more prominently and higher up in AI-generated search results, and expand its link 'carousel' under AI Overviews worldwide. The move comes as publishers warn of sharp referral traffic declines: consultancy Chartbeat reports news publishers saw a 40% drop in Google-referred traffic between July 2025 and July 2026 as AI summaries replaced link clicks.
tech.title: Google moves links higher in AI answers as publishers report 40% traffic plunge

tech.summary: ByteDance's AI research unit Seed created an Alignment & Preparedness team and launched a global recruitment drive for 10 researchers, calling it a long-term investment in AI safety for increasingly capable models. The team gets computing resources comparable to frontier-model teams, with positions in Beijing, Shanghai and San Jose. State media says Seed is the first Chinese frontier lab to establish a standalone safety and alignment department.
tech.title: ByteDance sets up AI safety team, launches global hiring drive

tech.summary: Amazon's Bee unveiled its first products since last year's acquisition: the $74.99 Bee Frontier wrist-worn/clip-on wearable and the $99.99 Bee Eclipse, a credit-card-sized phone attachment. Both use AI to turn conversations into notes, to-dos and summaries, with a free 14-day memory tier and a $11.99/month Bee Pro plan. Amazon claims raw audio is never stored, processed in real time then deleted, with transcripts encrypted by keys the user's own device controls.
tech.title: Amazon's Bee launches two AI wearables starting at $75

tech.summary: NVIDIA released three open-weight models: the 120-billion-parameter Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for always-on multimodal agents, the 74B-parameter Bolt 74B-A9B that fits in 24GB of memory via 2-bit quantization for local agentic workloads, and the tiny Bolt E4B 4GB for edge devices. NVIDIA claims Super VL delivers 5x the throughput of rival open models in its class and supports post-training on private data.
tech.title: NVIDIA launches three open-weight Nemotron 3.5 models for AI agents

tech.summary: Anchor, the browser-infrastructure company for AI agents, launched Action Index, a shared memory of successful web workflows that agents replay as deterministic code instead of reasoning through every click. On 300 Online-Mind2Web benchmark tasks, a small model with Action Index hit 93.3% success at $0.016 per task, matching a frontier model that cost $1.57 per task. Token use fell 74% and steps 75% in paired tests.
tech.title: Anchor launches Action Index, cutting AI agent token costs 100x

pakistan.summary: At least 33 people, including 32 children aged 6-14 and a teacher, were killed when the roof of the Al-Khair Education System School in Peshawar's Dir Colony collapsed during classes on Thursday morning. Around 40-50 others were injured. Heavy overnight rainfall may have weakened the two-story building. The school owner has been detained, President Zardari called for a comprehensive investigation, and KP's governor ordered a province-wide school safety audit.
pakistan.title: 32 children and a teacher killed as school roof collapses in Peshawar

pakistan.summary: Pakistan strongly condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's civilian and economic infrastructure at a UN Security Council debate on the Middle East, with acting permanent representative Usman Jadoon saying the attacks 'must cease immediately' and reaffirming Islamabad's support for the kingdom's security and right to self-defence. Pakistan also backed the UN envoy's efforts for a peaceful Yemen settlement and called for halting settler violence in the West Bank.
pakistan.title: At UNSC, Pakistan condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia

pakistan.summary: Under the daily fuel price mechanism, the government cut petrol by Rs3.63 to Rs390.23 per litre for Friday, while raising high-speed diesel by 31 paisas to Rs396.96. The revision comes a day after petrol was hiked Rs1.2 and diesel cut 17 paisas. Daily pricing, based on a seven-day average of international prices, replaced the weekly system in July as US-Iran tensions kept oil markets volatile, with Brent near $106.
pakistan.title: Govt cuts petrol by Rs3.63, raises diesel by 31 paisas for Oct 16

pakistan.summary: Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar met Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi on Thursday, and both are expected to hold fresh consultations on regional peace efforts on the sidelines of the OIC Council of Foreign Ministers meeting in Baghdad this weekend, Iran's IRNA reported. Foreign ministers from Pakistan, Egypt and Turkiye are expected to attend, with Tehran-Islamabad talks planned on the sidelines.
pakistan.title: Pakistan, Iran FMs to meet in Baghdad on regional peace

pakistan.summary: Sri Lanka opener Pathum Nissanka will miss the ODI tri-series against Pakistan and England after failing to get medical clearance for a left hamstring injury picked up during Sri Lanka's tour of England. Lahiru Udara replaces him in the 16-member squad, while former captain Charith Asalanka was dropped over poor ODI form. The seven-match series runs Oct 18-31 in Rawalpindi and Lahore, with Pakistan opening against Sri Lanka on Oct 18.
pakistan.title: Sri Lanka's Nissanka ruled out of ODI tri-series; Udara replaces him
